name: IAPullRequestReview
friendlyName: Pull Request Review by Azure OpenAI
description: This task uses Azure OpenAI model to review Pull Requests
author: Joao Antunes

inputs.name: use_https
inputs.label: Use Agent HTTPS
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select this option to use HTTPS for the agent.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: OpenAI model
inputs.helpMarkDown: The OpenAI model to use. not used if you use Azure OpenAI. if no model is selected, the GPT 3.5 Turbo model is used.

inputs.name: aoi_tokenMax
inputs.label: Max Tokens
inputs.helpMarkDown: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion. The token count of your request plus max_tokens cannot exceed the model's context size. (required)

inputs.name: aoi_temperature
inputs.label: Sampling Temperature (0-2)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values mean the model will take more risks. Try 0.9 for more creative applications and 0 for ones with a well-defined answer. (required)

inputs.name: additional_prompts
inputs.label: Additional Prompts
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Specify additional Azure OpenAI prompts as a comma-separated list to enhance the code review process.

- Add multiple prompts separated by commas.
- These prompts will be used in conjunction with the main code review prompts.

**Example:**
```plaintext
Check variable naming, ensure consistent indentation, review error handling approach
```

inputs.name: file_extensions
inputs.label: File Extensions
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Specify a comma-separated list of file extensions for which you want to perform a code review. This input helps narrow the scope of the code review to specific file types.

**Example:**
```plaintext
".js,.ts,.css,.html"
```

Make sure to provide file extensions without spaces after commas.

inputs.name: file_excludes
inputs.label: Files to Exclude
inputs.helpMarkDown:
## Files to Exclude from Configuration

### Description
Specify a comma-separated list of file names that should be excluded from code reviews. This is useful for excluding sensitive files or preventing certain files from being reviewed.

### Format
Provide a list of file names separated by commas. For example: `file1.js, file2.py, secret.txt`

### Default Value
If no files are specified, all files will be considered for code review by default.

inputs.name: support_self_signed_certificate
inputs.label: Support self-signed certificate
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select this option to support self-signed certificate.
